rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies a poor-quality early blastocyst with absent/degenerative ICM and TE and no hatching; notes possible partial collapse/re-expansion. Minor overinterpretation in calling it partially collapsed from a single image, but overall consistent with the image and reported 1DD grade.

Integrates age, ovarian reserve, oocyte maturity, endometrium, male factor, BMI/lifestyle, and first-cycle status with embryo quality. Could more explicitly distinguish embryo-driven prognosis from overall couple prognosis, but overall integration is strong.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent: poor morphology drives low implantation odds despite otherwise favorable patient factors. Probability estimate and counseling are supported, with only minor uncertainty around exact numeric range.

Generally aligned with Gardner grading interpretation and standard IVF counseling: poor-quality blastocyst has low implantation potential, transfer reasonable if only embryo, no bed rest, routine luteal support. Slight overreach in suggesting PGT-A broadly at age 35 without more nuance, but still mostly guideline-consistent.

Provides practical next steps for transfer, follow-up, and future cycle review, including male-factor workup and lifestyle optimization. Useful and nuanced, though some recommendations remain somewhat general rather than protocol-specific.
